description: This file defines the 'Counts' class which contains static methods implementing various counting functions such as COUNT, COUNTA, and COUNTBLANK for spreadsheet calculations within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Counts
classes.description: A class providing static methods for counting cells based on different criteria in spreadsheet calculations.

methods.name: COUNT
methods.description: Counts the number of cells that contain numeric values within the provided arguments.

methods.name: COUNTA
methods.description: Counts the number of non-empty cells within the provided arguments.

methods.name: COUNTBLANK
methods.description: Counts the number of empty cells within a range or array.
